title: USNI News Western Pacific Pulse: Oct. 2, 2026
summary: The following is a summary of major ship movements and exercises in the Western Pacific over the last week. In the Malacca Strait Destroyer USS Carl M. Levin (DDG-120) transited north through the Malacca Strait on Tuesday. The destroyer transited the Singapore Strait the day before. Carl M. Levin is now operating in the Indian Ocean. Homeported in Hawaii, Carl M. Levin is forward deployed and assigned to Destroyer Squadron (DESRON) 15 In Singapore Royal Navy offshore patrol vessel HMS Tamar (P233) is docked in Singapore for maintenance.
